BUYING & PROJECT PLANNING

Stadium Cup Sizes: Compare Serving Volume and Configuration

Specify the required serving portion and distinguish a listed capacity option from the finished order specification.

Prepare a Project Enquiry →

Capacity is only one comparison

A 2 oz mini cup and a full-size event cup serve different tasks. SJB-030 and SJB-031 are recorded as 2 oz mini models; review them for small-portion service, not ordinary full-size drink distribution.

Write the capacity option explicitly

When a model lists multiple options, select the required option. Also ask which filling reference is used; do not treat a nominal capacity as a promised menu pour.

Compare the event workflow

Check lid and straw components, artwork space, storage and distribution. SJB-049 is factory-confirmed stackable; the final stacking and transport arrangement still belongs in the brief.

Before Sending the Enquiry

Review itemWhat to send
Model & portionSKU, vessel shape and required capacity option.
Use & configurationBeverage, temperature conditions, lid, straw or other components.
